name: Hope Utilities AEP Fuel Cell Data Center Pipeline

values.PipelineName: Hope Utilities AEP Fuel Cell Data Center Pipeline

researcher_notes: Hope Utilities announced on August 14, 2025 that its subsidiary Northeast Ohio Natural Gas Corporation will build, own and run a new natural gas pipeline in central Ohio to supply a fuel cell project that American Electric Power is developing for a new data center. The trade press story says service is to start by October 2026. It gives no length, diameter, counties or site. No construction start was found, so status is proposed. Ohio regulators approved AEP Ohio onsite fuel cells at Amazon Web Services and Cologix data centers in May 2025 (WOSU story); the pipeline source does not say which site, so the link between the two is likely but not stated. DataCenterNotes: the pipeline source names the data center project directly. Start, end, length and route are blank until a source gives them. No existing row matches. The Prosperity Line is a different West Virginia project. The owner name has no legal-form match in the entity list; recorded as the source spells it. Confidence is medium because there is one trade press source for the pipeline itself.
